name: com.igp.custom-unity-cli
description: Static declaration of the cucli surface. The 'offline' section is served by Tools/cucli.ps1 itself. The 'groups' section is generated from the compiled Editor worker by 'cucli commands export' so that 'cucli commands list' works even while Unity is closed; an empty array only degrades offline listing, never dispatch. Project-local commands are deliberately NOT written here: they go to registry.local.json inside the project's extension area, outside this package, so project code can never be published with the package.
